### Setup

::: panel-tabset
#### Libraries
```{r libraries}
#| code-fold: show
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(targets)
library(gt)
```

#### Reading
```{r reading}
#| code-fold: show
tar_load(c(dat, testdat, predictors, rhats, tracerank_plts, trace_plts,
           ppc_plt, ppc_plt_g), 
         store = here::here("_targets"))
```
:::

## Results

#### Model Diagnostics

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="33%"}
```{r rhats}
top_nine <- rhats |>
  head(9)

top_nine |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number() |>
  tab_style(cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            cells_column_labels()) |>
  tab_footnote("Rhat values sorted highest to lowest." |>
                 str_wrap(10) |> html()) |>
  tab_options(table.width = px(180))
```
:::
